newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brown cuts excise tax on "green" trucks/buses.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown cuts excise tax on "green" trucks/buses.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said he will cut excise duties on lorries and buses that meet low emission standards and will examine the case for charges on polluters.
"To reduce pollution, lorries and buses that meet low emission standards will, from next year, attract a reduction of vehicle excise duty by a maximum of 500 pounds," Brown told parliament.

"Too little is being done to discourage water pollution. The environmental case for charges on polluters need to be examined carefully," he said. The extraction of aggregates also inflict damage to the landscape, he said.
"After period of consultation, I will return with any proposals in these two ares in my next budget."
